result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, my top recommendation is **1Password**\.

It's an excellent balance of security, ease of use, administration, and team collaboration. But there are a few strong alternatives depending on your budget and how technical your team is.

## Best password managers for small teams

![Get to know 1Password for Mac | 1Password Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/C4U7UvvWr1lsit0fdwRMADZs7wYIji_AIA_d_hCeSHTTS1dPoJwwNeSzAPqWszRkpvDsM-p6I-6bznHJsD41eDQWYBj0MySy4qOfvgyzlD_4z3rPSGN9LVxo1hBQTb8qLml3yarSFkZEwcSqyJe7UAnBKtGHsXMSYuWNAwGS3UO1kE8Ogcbnaa14C9ioehoa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent, polished apps and browser extensions.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Strong administrator controls and employee offboarding.
- Security monitoring through Watchtower.
  
  Canadian pricing: Teams Starter Pack around C\$29.95/month for up to 10 people, billed annually.
  
  [1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source core.
- Very competitive pricing.
- Shared collections and administrator controls.
- Good option for technically minded teams.
  
  Teams: approximately US\$4/user/month, billed annually.
  
  [Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**
**Best for administrative controls**

- Shared folders and delegated administration.
- Strong security and compliance capabilities.
- Useful for businesses with more formal IT requirements.
  
  Entry plans start around US\$2/user/month, subject to plan limits.
  
  [Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**
**Best for security monitoring**

- Password health reporting.
- Phishing and credential-risk protection.
- Useful administrative dashboard.
  
  Business pricing around US\$8/user/month on published plans.
  
  [Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Pricing is indicative, not a quote. Canadian taxes, currency conversion and plan changes may affect the final cost. [www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to two\:

| If you prioritize... | Choose |
|--------|--------|
| Ease of use and adoption | 1Password |
| Lowest cost and flexibility | Bitwarden |
| More advanced administration | Keeper |


For most small businesses, I'd choose 1Password. A password manager only works if everyone actually uses it, and 1Password makes that relatively painless.

## Four things I'd insist on

Whichever product you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Share company credentials without sending passwords through email or Slack.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Everyone has their own login; no shared master account.
3. **Offboarding\:** Immediately revoke access when an employee leaves.
4. **MFA\:** Require multifactor authentication for everyone, ideally using passkeys or security keys.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

How many people are on your team?
